headline: Four dress watches under $4,000
stop_reason: Validator passes, but two photos do not match their watch: the Cartier slide shows a gold Tank model worn by a model, not the steel WSTA0135, and the Tissot library photo is a leather-strap blue-dial Le Locle that does not match the ref (ref_on_page false). Fixing needs a verified matching photo for Cartier and Tissot. Dropping either slot leaves three collections, below the four-slot minimum. Not posted.
